video_caption: The video opens with a static dark gray background. Centered on the screen is a title in a vibrant orange-to-yellow gradient font with a slight shadow, reading "Song Structure." Below this title, a list of song parts is presented vertically in clear white text: "Verse," "Pre-Chorus," "Chorus," "Verse," "Pre-Chorus," "Chorus," "Bridge," "Chorus," and "Outro." The speaker's voice states, "As usual, we're going to start with the song structure to break down the different parts we need to learn in this song." The visual remains unchanged throughout this brief segment.

The video opens with a black screen displaying the title "Guitar Parts" in orange text, followed by a numbered list of song sections: "1. Verse (1:55)", "2. Pre-Chorus (3:41)", "3. Chorus (5:27)", and "4. Bridge (7:18)" in white text, while an unseen speaker discusses the song's structure. This transitions to another black screen with "Check The Description" in orange text, and "Chords + Lyrics + Techniques" in white text, with a large orange downward arrow, as the speaker prompts viewers to access additional resources. The scene then changes to a close-up of a person's hands, wearing a black t-shirt and blue jeans, as they place a capo on the first fret of a light brown acoustic guitar, against a white background, following the speaker's instructions. Finally, a medium shot shows a man with short brown hair and a beard, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, standing against a white background. He gestures with both hands giving thumbs up, then points downwards with both hands, and concludes by resting his hands on his hips, as he requests engagement with the video.

The video opens with a man with a beard and short dark hair, wearing a black v-neck t-shirt, smiling and gesturing towards the camera against a plain white background. He talks, and then the scene transitions to a split screen with a dark grey background. The left side displays "Song Structure" (orange) and a list of song parts: "Verse," "Pre-Chorus," "Chorus," "Verse," "Pre-Chorus," "Chorus," "Bridge," "Chorus," "Outro." The text "Verse" is highlighted in orange, then the highlight moves to "Pre-Chorus" and down the list as acoustic guitar music with singing plays. The right side shows "Verse" (orange) and the lyrics: "I thought that I've been hurt before / But no one's ever left me quite this sore / Your words cut deeper than a knife / Now I need someone to breathe me back to life." The scene then transitions again to a different split screen. The upper part shows a man's hands strumming an acoustic guitar, with a capo on the second fret, set against a white background. The lower part of the screen, also dark grey, displays the chords "Am G C F" and a strumming pattern represented by arrows (down and up) and text "1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &," with the arrows highlighting to indicate the strumming rhythm as the guitar plays.

In this video segment, a person wearing a dark short-sleeved top and dark blue jeans is shown playing a light brown acoustic guitar, which has a black capo clamped to its second fret. Their left hand is on the fretboard, forming various chord shapes, while their right hand strums with a pick. Initially, four chord diagrams for Am, G, C, and F chords appear sequentially on the screen, illustrating finger placements. At 0:14, these chord diagrams are replaced by a dark grey bar at the bottom of the screen, which displays the chord progression "Am G C F". Below this bar, a strumming pattern is shown with arrows and numbers: "↓ 1 & ↑ & ↓ 2 & ↑ & ↓ 3 & ↑ & ↓ 4 & ↑ &," where down arrows (↓) represent downstrokes and up arrows (↑) represent upstrokes, corresponding to the beats. The person demonstrates this strumming pattern, counting out the beats and strums aloud while playing each chord for one bar. At 1:28, the scene transitions to a dark grey screen with two text boxes. The left box, titled "Song Structure," lists the parts of a song: "Verse, Pre-Chorus, Chorus, Verse, Pre-Chorus, Chorus, Bridge, Chorus, Outro," with "Pre-Chorus" highlighted in orange. The right box, also titled "Pre-Chorus," displays the lyrics: "Got a feeling that I'm going under But I know that I'll make it out alive If I quit calling you my lover Move on." During this transition, the person continues to play the guitar softly, demonstrating the chords and strumming.

In this video segment, a person wearing a black t-shirt and blue jeans is seated, playing an acoustic guitar with a capo on the second fret. Their right hand uses a yellow pick to strum the strings, while their left hand expertly frets chords on the guitar neck. The background is a clean white, with a decorative orange and yellow gradient bar at the bottom separating the video frame from informational text. As the person plays, a chord progression is visually displayed: first, "F" appears with its corresponding chord diagram (fingers 1st fret B string, 2nd fret G string, 3rd fret D string, 3rd fret A string), followed by "G" with its diagram (fingers 2nd fret A string, 3rd fret low E string, 3rd fret B string, 3rd fret high E string). Next, "Am" is shown with its diagram (fingers 1st fret B string, 2nd fret D string, 2nd fret G string), and finally, "G" reappears with its diagram.

In a well-lit studio with a white background, a man wearing a black shirt and blue jeans sits, holding a brown acoustic guitar with a capo on the second fret. His left hand is positioned on the fretboard, and his right hand, holding a yellow guitar pick, is poised over the strings. A black horizontal bar at the bottom of the screen displays a strumming pattern with white text and arrows. On the left side of the bar, a downward arrow is above the number "1," followed by an upward arrow above "&," then another downward arrow above "2," and an upward arrow above "&." Above this black bar, an orange bar displays the chord progression in white text: "F G Am G." The man speaks, explaining that they will play on the one and the two beats for the first two beats, then on the beat and the "and" for the third and fourth beats.

The video shows a person from the chest down, wearing a dark shirt and blue jeans, sitting and playing a brown acoustic guitar with a capo on the second fret. The person's right hand strums the strings with a pick while their left hand forms chords on the fretboard. Initially, chord diagrams appear on the bottom left of the screen, showing "Am" (A minor), "G," "C," and "F" chords with finger placements, as the person plays each chord. Then, a dark grey bar appears at the bottom of the screen, displaying the chord names "Am G C F" along with a strumming pattern represented by arrows (down and up strokes) and counts ("1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &"), illustrating how to play the rhythm. The person demonstrates this strumming pattern multiple times, switching between the chords. After a short while, the strumming pattern overlay disappears, replaced by a "Song Structure" list on the left side, showing "Verse," "Pre-Chorus," "Chorus," "Verse," "Pre-Chorus," "Chorus," "Bridge," "Chorus," and "Outro," with "Bridge" highlighted in orange. On the right, a "Bridge" section displays lyrics: "Needle and the thread, gotta get you out of my head / Needle and the thread, gonna wind up dead / Needle and the thread, gotta get you out of my head / Needle and the thread, gonna wind up dead...". The person continues to play the guitar while these lyrics are shown, then the strumming pattern overlay reappears at the bottom of the screen with the chords "Am G C F" and the player continues to demonstrate the pattern.

A man wearing a black short-sleeved shirt and blue jeans is seated, demonstrating guitar playing on an acoustic guitar with a capo clamped on the first fret. His left hand frets chords while his right hand holds a pick, demonstrating strumming. Initially, four guitar chord diagrams are displayed at the bottom: "Am" (A minor), "G" (G major), "C" (C major), and "F" (F major), showing finger positions for these chords (00:06-00:19). The man briefly strums each of these chords. Then, the scene transitions to show a strumming pattern diagram (00:20-end) at the bottom, replacing the chord diagrams. This diagram features the chord names "Am G C F" above a sequence of downward-pointing arrows (representing downstrokes) and ampersands "&" (representing upstrokes) that mark the rhythm "1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &". The man explains and demonstrates palm muting by lightly resting the side of his right palm against the bridge of the guitar while strumming, creating a partially muted sound on the beats "1" and the "and" of each beat, contrasting it with a fully open sound, and then performing the muted strumming pattern repeatedly.

A man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, stands in front of a plain white background, looking directly at the camera. He points his right index finger downwards and slightly to his left while speaking, then raises and extends his right arm to point horizontally to his right.
